archReview.notes: VP9 idct_idct 16x16 add RVV (libavcodec/riscv/vp9itxfm_rvv.S): processes the block in two 8-column halves with e32 m1 (8 lanes) lane-wise 16-point butterflies (stage1 t*a + stage2 t + stage3 rotations + stage4 + stage5 + outputs, verified against C dataflow). Pass 1 loads 16 row vectors per half (vle16, stride 32 bytes), runs vp9_idct16_1d (which applies the C COLUMN transform since IN(x)=block[x*16+i] spreads over lane i of the row vectors), narrows (vnsrl.wi in e32 mode), stores column-wise (vsse16, stride 32) into stack tmp[]; block zeroed via vl=16 stores (caller contract). Pass 2 reloads tmp[] rows, same butterfly, accumulates (out+(1<<(6-1)))>>6 with clip [0,255]. DC-only path (eob==1) via scalar t + splat accumulate. Sim: 20 cases x 3 eob (1/8/256) = 0/15360 byte-exact vs C (dst block region + zeroed block). arch-scan 0.
